title: Figure 113: cylinder UAP Mach number at 1300 mph supersonic CFD contour
description: Single CFD contour plot of Mach number around the cylinder UAP at 1/6 scale, air temperature 223K and 1300 mph with supersonic inlet and supersonic outlet. Shows supersonic orange free stream, shock deceleration ahead of the blunt face, and a subsonic blue wake. Final figure of the BAASS cylinder CFD series.
